- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially +0.40 or higher) — reduce forecast peak values by 5–15%.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (0.00 or negative) — add 2–8% to forecast to account for mean reversion.
- Avoid long-term overconfidence after recent price spikes — cap 30d forecast peaks at 10% above recent 18d high.
- If sentiment history shows no strong trend, forecast should not drift >3% from recent 18d mean — apply smoothing or decay filter.
- Overshoots after sharp upward moves (e.g., +10%+ from prior day) should be capped at 2–3 days of lagged price before correction.
- When sentiment is consistently 0.00, assume low volatility — forecast should not exceed 1.5x recent 18d range unless triggered by external event.
